categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in electronic components manufacturing, electronic materials wholesale, communication machinery manufacturing, and instrument manufacturing. Key products include high-precision metal masks for AMOLED display panel deposition, heat dissipation module materials, precision cleaning and regeneration services, biomedical instruments and consumables, and design and development of high-power microwave/millimeter-wave measurement instruments. The company also engages in semiconductor equipment components manufacturing and maintenance through subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The core technology is precision metal etching, enabling multi-stage etching and alignment techniques to meet diverse design requirements. The company has developed complete production technologies for OLED display panel metal masks from G2.5 to G6H sizes, including photomask design, lamination, exposure, development, etching, stripping, cleaning, precision measurement, tensioning, and laser spot welding. It also applies precision etching to produce ultra-thin heat dissipation materials and components, and develops new products for semiconductor, energy, and biomedical fields.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are OLED display panel manufacturers, semiconductor industry players, and companies requiring heat dissipation solutions. The company serves markets including smartphones, VR/MR devices, wearable devices, tablets, laptops, TVs, automotive electronics, and defense industries. It also targets emerging markets such as AI-driven smart glasses and high-performance computing requiring advanced thermal management.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan and China, with subsidiaries in Shanghai and Vietnam. It serves global markets, including China, Korea, and other regions involved in AMOLED panel production and electronics manufacturing. The company leverages regional and cultural advantages to collaborate closely with Chinese panel manufacturers and expand its market share in mainland China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, specializing in precision metal etching for metal masks used in OLED panel deposition and heat dissipation components. It supplies metal mask sheets to mask manufacturers rather than directly to panel makers, positioning itself as a specialized subcontractor. It also provides precision cleaning and regeneration services and manufactures components for semiconductor equipment through subsidiaries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing etching technology, improving production efficiency, expanding etching product lines, and developing new customers. R&D focuses on heat dissipation, energy, and semiconductor metal etching components and materials. The company aims to deepen its expertise in precision metal masks and heat dissipation materials, broaden product applications, and diversify business to reduce operational risks. Innovation includes ultra-thin vapor chamber components and advanced OLED mask technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of precision metal masks, heat dissipation materials, precision cleaning services, and electronic components. The company also earns income from manufacturing and maintenance services for semiconductor equipment components via subsidiaries. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models but focuses on direct sales and contract manufacturing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces intense competition in the AMOLED mask market, especially from Chinese local manufacturers due to market localization policies. It differentiates itself through high-precision etching technology, strong customer partnerships, and regional advantages. The company is transitioning to a specialized mask sheet etching manufacturer, collaborating with strategic partners to access end customers in China. It holds a competitive position by focusing on technical barriers and product quality in the midstream supply chain.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately NT$891 million, a 21% decrease from the previous year, but improved gross margin by 17%. It reduced operating losses significantly and narrowed net losses by 30%. The company employs around 388 employees with a stable workforce and invests about 8.7% of revenue in R&D. It is in a transformation phase with plans to expand production capacity and product lines, aiming for sustainable growth despite recent revenue declines.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its proprietary high-precision metal etching technology, enabling ultra-fine patterning and multi-stage etching to meet stringent OLED panel manufacturing requirements. It offers comprehensive lifecycle solutions from design consultation to cleaning and regeneration, ensuring high product quality and yield. Its ability to produce ultra-thin heat dissipation components addresses the growing demand for lightweight, efficient thermal management in advanced electronics. The company leverages deep industry knowledge and close customer collaboration to create high entry barriers and deliver tailored, cost-competitive solutions.
